name: Rotator Cuff Pull with Band
summary: Elbows tucked at the waist and a band held across upturned palms: the hands press apart, turning the forearms out.
steps: Kneel, sit or stand tall with elbows bent by the waist, palms up.
Lay the band across the palms and take hold.
Breathe out to press the hands apart, elbows staying put.

layers.title: Pulses
layers.text: Small pulses at the open position.

layers.title: Change the base
layers.text: Kneeling up, a lunge, or standing on one leg.

modifications: Slack in the band for less resistance.
cues:
Elbows stay close to the ribs.
Chest open and lifted.
Slow out, slower in.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
